purpose: Resolve the measured missing-expert audit coverage in R2_P1B with geometry-only support probes, without changing the network or its frozen cover.
support_probe_rule: For every frozen compact patch, use the solid point with maximum unnormalized local window on a fixed 33x33 local grid; if empty, repeat at 65 then 129. Append one point per patch to the unchanged 12000 uniform audit points. Reject if no non-negligible support is found. This is an audit point set, not a training sampling protocol.
checks: at least one geometry-admitted local probe per expert
stop_rule: No scientific training until the failed expert-coverage condition and all derivative/budget checks pass. Training later needs a separately registered common point distribution and physical averaging convention.
